title: Marigold
venue_description:
Marigold

Marigold is a converted historic theater and cafe complex on Cottage Street in downtown Easthampton, spanning three connected storefronts that house a full concert hall, an attached cafe and bar, and a performance room known as Amy's Place. It is one of the anchor music venues of the Easthampton arts scene, mixing touring and local bands with a monthly open mic and jam night.

Atmosphere and Setting

The main hall is a proper small theater rather than a bar — a real stage, house sound, and a seated or standing audience built for listening. The attached cafe, added in 2025, serves snacks and drinks to concertgoers before and during shows, softening the room into more of a neighborhood hangout on quieter nights.

Open Mic & Jam

On the first Thursday of every month, Marigold turns the stage over to the community for a fully backlined Open Mic & Jam hosted by Tobey Sol LaRoche. Sign-up starts at 6:30 PM, with 15-minute performance slots beginning at 7:00 PM on a first-come basis. At 10:00 PM the format shifts into a free-for-all open jam. Bands and first-time performers are given priority over solo repeat performers, and the house supplies drums and amps so electric acts can plug in and play.

Other Programming

Beyond the monthly jam, Marigold runs a packed calendar of ticketed touring and local band shows throughout the year. The venue also has a sister location, Marigold, in Brattleboro, Vermont, opened under the same ownership in 2024.

Good to Know

Marigold sits at 84 Cottage Street in Easthampton, with the cafe next door at 82 Cottage Street and the open mic itself staged at 80 Cottage Street — all part of one connected building. Free to attend and open to all ages and skill levels.

title: Luthier's Co-op
venue_description:
Luthier's Co-op

Self-described as the world's first full-service guitar bar, Luthier's Co-op in Easthampton combines a working instrument shop with the Backstage Bar, a small music-centric watering hole pouring local beer and a house ginger drink. The shop buys, sells, trades, repairs, and appraises guitars, basses, banjos, amps, mandolins, and ukuleles, and offers lessons and tube amp repair on the side.

Atmosphere and Setting

The vibe is unmistakably musician-first — instruments line the walls, and the bar exists as much for players hanging around the shop as for anyone stopping in for a drink. It is a welcoming, low-pressure room built for people who already care about gear.

Open Mic Nights

Luthier's runs open mic nights twice a week: Tuesdays with sign-up from 8:00 PM and a start around 8:30 PM, and Wednesdays with sign-up from 6:30 PM and a 7:00 PM start. Both are open to all instruments and skill levels.

Other Programming

Beyond the open mics, Luthier's hosts a monthly comedy night on the first Tuesday, a spoken word night called Unbuttoned on the second Tuesday, and an Art Walk Jazz Night on the second Saturday, making it one of the busiest small stages in Easthampton.

Good to Know

Luthier's Co-op is at 108 Cottage Street, Easthampton. The shop keeps daytime retail hours Tuesday through Saturday, while the bar stays open into the evening for its music programming.

title: CitySpace
venue_description:
CitySpace

CitySpace is a community arts and event space inside Easthampton's Old Town Hall, run as part of the city's Art Walk Easthampton initiative. It is a municipal hall rather than a bar — free, all-ages, and built around civic and cultural programming for the whole community.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Blue Room inside Old Town Hall is bright and open, with the feel of a town gathering space rather than a nightlife venue. That makes it an easy, pressure-free room for musicians who might not seek out a bar-based jam.

CitySpace Bluegrass

On the first Saturday of every month, CitySpace hosts a strings-only bluegrass jam from 4:00 to 7:00 PM, founded and led by David Clark Carroll of the progressive bluegrass band Daring Coyotes. Pickers, singers, and strummers of every skill level are welcome, no sign-up required, and the earlier daytime slot lets working musicians join in before evening commitments.

Other Programming

CitySpace also runs a broader Partners in Performance series and supports Easthampton's citywide Art Walk events throughout the year.

Good to Know

CitySpace is located at 43 Main Street in Easthampton's Old Town Hall. The bluegrass jam launched in February 2025 and has run monthly since.

title: JJ's Tavern
venue_description:
JJ's Tavern

Founded by Jon and Jen Neumann in 2013, JJ's Tavern is a neighborhood tavern in the Florence section of Northampton known for an elevated menu that goes well beyond typical bar food, a private banquet space, and a lively outdoor pavilion.

Atmosphere and Setting

JJ's positions itself as a comfortable, all-are-welcome gathering spot for the community, the kind of place that hosts everything from casual dinners to milestone celebrations, with live entertainment as a regular part of the calendar.

Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday, JJ's opens its floor to original songs, covers, and singalongs at its weekly open mic, hosted by Shawn Gunderson, known locally as Gundy. Doors open at 6:00 PM, sign-ups begin at 6:30 PM, and music runs from 7:00 to 10:00 PM.

Other Programming

JJ's also runs a separate weekly comedy open mic called Just Jokes on another night, alongside its regular dinner and event programming.

Good to Know

JJ's Tavern is at 99 Main Street in Florence. The kitchen serves a full menu alongside the open mic, and the outdoor pavilion adds extra seating in warmer months.

title: The Parlor Room
venue_description:
The Parlor Room

The Parlor Room is a listening room in downtown Northampton run by the Iron Horse Entertainment Group, the organization behind the historic Iron Horse Music Hall next door. It also houses the Parlor School of Music, offering lessons alongside its performance programming.

Atmosphere and Setting

True to its billing as a listening room, the Parlor Room favors quiet attention and sound quality over bar-jam volume — an intimate space built for songwriters and storytellers rather than a loud crowd.

Open Mic Series

On Tuesday nights, the Parlor Room hosts two rotating monthly open mics: a Song and Story Open Mic for songs, stories, poems, and works in progress, and a Queer Open Mic for LGBTQ+ artists, performers, and writers. Both are hosted by local songwriters and run with sign-up required.

Other Programming

As part of the Iron Horse family of venues, the Parlor Room's calendar also includes ticketed singer-songwriter shows and events tied to the Parlor School of Music.

Good to Know

The Parlor Room is located at 32 Masonic Street in Northampton, next door to the Iron Horse Music Hall.

title: VFW Post 8428 (Belchertown VFW)
venue_description:
VFW Post 8428

VFW Post 8428, known locally as the Belchertown VFW, is a classic veterans' post hall that opens its doors to the community for live music alongside its usual member functions.

Atmosphere and Setting

Like most VFW halls in the region, it is an informal, unpretentious space — a community hall rather than a commercial bar, with a welcoming, low-key feel for both performers and neighbors dropping in to listen.

Open Mic Night

The post hosts a weekly open mic on Wednesday evenings starting at 6:00 PM, open to all styles and skill levels in true VFW-hall fashion.

Other Programming

Beyond its music night, the post also books occasional live bands for member and community events throughout the year.

Good to Know

VFW Post 8428 is located at 41 Pelham Road in Belchertown. As with many veterans' halls, it is worth checking the post's Facebook page ahead of a visit in case of schedule changes.

title: Hatfield Pub
venue_description:
Hatfield Pub

Hatfield Pub is known throughout the Pioneer Valley for in-house made food, including pastrami sandwiches and smoked meats, alongside a regular live music calendar.

Atmosphere and Setting

It is a food-forward neighborhood pub that draws a loyal local following, popular enough that the pub asks patrons to reserve at least two weeks ahead for its bigger event nights.

Bluegrass Jam

Thursday nights bring a bluegrass jam, pairing acoustic pickers with the pub's smoked and cured house specialties for a casual, food-and-music evening.

Other Programming

The pub's calendar rotates through other live entertainment as well, drawing on its reputation as a food-and-music destination in Hatfield.

Good to Know

Hatfield Pub is located at 312 West Street in Hatfield.

title: Tangle Chocolate
venue_description:
Tangle Chocolate

Tangle Chocolate is a bean-to-bar chocolate maker in the Williamsburg Market building on Route 9, known for premium handmade chocolate alongside a cozy community-arts-cafe atmosphere.

Atmosphere and Setting

The shop's warm, artisanal feel makes it a natural home for a multi-disciplinary open mic rather than a typical bar jam — sweets, beer, and hard cider are available for purchase during the show.

Open Mic Night

On the second Friday of every month, Tangle hosts an open mic that explicitly welcomes musicians, storytellers, comics, and poets alike, from 6:30 to 9:00 PM.

Other Programming

Beyond the open mic, Tangle's space regularly hosts community arts events tied to its chocolate-making business.

Good to Know

Tangle Chocolate is located at 5 Main Street (Route 9) in Williamsburg, next door to the Williamsburg General Store.

title: The O's Music Bar
venue_description:
The O's Music Bar

The O's Music Bar, formerly known as Snowzee's, calls itself the Pioneer Valley's best kept secret — a live music bar near the UMass Amherst corridor with a full sound system built for bands, DJs, and more.

Atmosphere and Setting

The O's is a proper music-bar setting with pool tables and a late-night crowd, running a varied nightlife calendar beyond just its jam nights.

Bluegrass Jam

Thursday nights bring a dedicated Bluegrass Jam, a recurring gathering for pickers and acoustic players in a room built for live sound.

Other Programming

Beyond the bluegrass jam, The O's regularly books bands, DJs, and other live entertainment as part of its late-night lineup.

Good to Know

The O's Music Bar is on Route 116 in Sunderland, near the UMass Amherst campus corridor.

title: Ciro's
venue_description:
Ciro's

Ciro's is a traditional Italian restaurant and bar in Springfield's South End, a longtime neighborhood dinner spot that also runs a weekly music night on its bar side.

Atmosphere and Setting

Ciro's leans into classic Italian-American dining — a full menu and bar — with entertainment layered in as a weekly draw rather than the main event, giving the open mic a relaxed, restaurant-bar feel.

LC's Open Mic Night

Every Monday, Ciro's hosts LC's open mic, a long-running weekly tradition on the bar side with half-price drink and appetizer specials for the night.

Other Programming

Ciro's also books occasional live saxophonists and separately runs stand-up comedy nights with touring comics on other evenings.

Good to Know

Ciro's is located at 912 Main Street in Springfield's South End.

title: 99 Restaurant & Pub
venue_description:
99 Restaurant & Pub

The Chicopee location of 99 Restaurants, a familiar regional chain, hosts a monthly acoustic open mic run by an outside host in an easygoing, casual-dining pub setting.

Atmosphere and Setting

As a chain restaurant and pub, 99 offers a comfortable, food-and-drink-focused atmosphere — a low-pressure room for acoustic performers rather than a dedicated music venue.

Acoustic Open Mic

On a monthly Wednesday, the pub hosts an Acoustic Open Mic run by Robin Finlay and Friends, who bring sound equipment so performers can simply show up and play.

Other Programming

As a full-service restaurant chain location, 99's calendar otherwise centers on standard dining rather than additional live entertainment.

Good to Know

This 99 Restaurant & Pub is located at 555 Memorial Drive in Chicopee.

title: The Whip
venue_description:
The Whip

The Whip, also known locally as Whip City Bar & Grill, is a neighborhood bar and grill in Westfield with a full food menu, a dance floor, and a regular live-entertainment lineup. Its name nods to Westfield's own nickname, Whip City.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Whip is a classic bar-and-grill hangout, open daily into the early morning hours, with entertainment as a core part of its weekly identity.

Blue Monday Blues Jam

Monday nights bring the Blue Monday blues jam, an open mic and blues jam session that has become a weekly fixture for the bar.

Other Programming

The Whip also runs karaoke on other nights as part of its regular entertainment calendar.

Good to Know

The Whip is located at 287 North Elm Street in Westfield.

title: Bright Ideas Brewing (Westfield)
venue_description:
Bright Ideas Brewing

Bright Ideas Brewing is a family- and dog-friendly craft brewery with multiple Massachusetts taprooms, including this location in Westfield. It runs a full events calendar spanning music, trivia, and comedy.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Westfield taproom has the easygoing feel typical of a modern craft brewery — approachable, casual, and geared toward community gathering as much as beer.

Open Mic Night & Ted's Thursday Jams

On rotating Thursdays, the taproom hosts a music-focused Open Mic Night alongside a related recurring session called Ted's Thursday Jams, both distinct from the brewery's separately branded comedy nights.

Other Programming

Bright Ideas Westfield also runs trivia nights and standalone comedy shows as part of its broader weekly calendar.

Good to Know

Bright Ideas Brewing's Westfield taproom is located at 109 Apremont Way.

title: The Southwick Inn
venue_description:
The Southwick Inn

The Southwick Inn is a longtime restaurant and bar on College Highway in Southwick with an established weekly live-music program built around two regular nights.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Inn has the feel of a classic small-town restaurant and bar, with a loyal following for its live entertainment as much as its food.

Open Mic Night

Every Thursday from 7:00 to 10:00 PM, local musician Steve Piper hosts an open mic — bring your instrument and sign up on arrival.

Other Programming

Wednesdays bring a rotating featured artist from 6:00 to 8:30 PM with food specials, and the Inn also hosts larger seasonal events like an Oktoberfest and holiday parties.

Good to Know

The Southwick Inn is located at 479 College Highway in Southwick. Interested performers can reach out via email or Facebook to get involved.

title: The Guilded Brick
venue_description:
The Guilded Brick

The Guilded Brick is a Holyoke bar and performance space with a dedicated open mic series popular enough to have its own social media presence separate from the venue's main page.

Atmosphere and Setting

Listed among Holyoke's arts and culture venues, The Guilded Brick leans into its role as a home for local performers, with the open mic as a signature recurring program.

Open Mic Night

Held on the third Thursday of the month, the open mic runs with both online and in-person sign-up options starting around 6:30 PM.

Other Programming

The Guilded Brick's open mic has built a following distinct enough to run its own branded social media account, suggesting a steady, community-driven series.

Good to Know

The Guilded Brick is located at 380 Dwight Street in Holyoke. As with any monthly series, it's worth checking ahead for the current month's date.

title: El Cid
venue_description:
El Cid

El Cid, also known as El Cid Lounge, is a Ludlow cocktail lounge with roughly a 50-year operating history, open late into the night, seven days a week.

Atmosphere and Setting

El Cid has the feel of a classic neighborhood nightclub-lounge, staying open until 1 or 2 AM most nights, with periodic live music as part of its entertainment mix.

Open Mic Night

On the first Friday of the month, El Cid hosts a Friday night open mic, with the venue regularly reaching out on social media for performers to fill the lineup.

Other Programming

Beyond the monthly open mic, El Cid functions as a late-night lounge with a long local following in Ludlow.

Good to Know

El Cid is located at 1002 East Street in Ludlow.

title: PJ's Town Crier
venue_description:
PJ's Town Crier

PJ's Town Crier is a neighborhood sports bar and restaurant across from a lake in rural Holland, built around a regular entertainment calendar that includes a well-established weekly open mic.

Atmosphere and Setting

PJ's has the relaxed feel of a small-town sports bar, drawing a loyal community crowd for its food, games, and live entertainment.

Sunday Open Mic

Every Sunday, PJ's hosts an open mic popular enough to have its own dedicated social media page, with house gear available so performers do not need to bring their own equipment.

Other Programming

PJ's also runs regular karaoke nights alongside its open mic, rounding out its weekly entertainment lineup.

Good to Know

PJ's Town Crier is located at 154 Mashapaug Road in Holland.

title: Husky's Pub
venue_description:
Husky's Pub

Husky's Pub is a neighborhood bar near Worcester's Park Avenue with a weekly night mixing music and comedy on its open floor.

Atmosphere and Setting

Husky's has the relaxed, unpretentious feel of a corner neighborhood pub, popular with the surrounding Park Avenue community.

Open Mic Night

Wednesday nights bring an open mic that mixes music and comedy performers on the same bill, running from 7:00 to 10:00 PM.

Other Programming

Husky's separately runs a Sunday comedy-only open mic, distinct from its Wednesday music-and-comedy night.

Good to Know

Husky's Pub is located at 413 Park Avenue in Worcester.

title: Electric Haze
venue_description:
Electric Haze

Electric Haze is a 21+ entertainment space in Worcester's Canal District, housed in a former midcentury department store building. It pours specialty cocktails, craft beer, and wine alongside hookah service and a serious live-music calendar — touring jam bands like Spafford have recorded live albums here.

Atmosphere and Setting

The room has an artsy, lounge-like feel distinct from a typical bar, with a layout built for both listening and dancing.

The Space Jam

Every Wednesday from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM, Electric Haze hosts The Space Jam, a funk-flavored open jam hosted by Brandon "Sunshine" Esteves. The house provides guitar, bass, a Hammond keyboard, a full drum kit, a percussion station, and two live microphones, with 20-minute sets signed up on a sheet at the bar.

Other Programming

Electric Haze's broader calendar features touring and local jam, funk, and improvisational acts throughout the year.

Good to Know

Electric Haze is located at 26 Millbury Street in Worcester's Canal District.

title: Courthouse Brew Co.
venue_description:
Courthouse Brew Co.

Courthouse Brew Co. is a craft brewery and taproom in Worcester housed in a historic converted mill building on Brussels Street, known for its inviting taproom and a well-established weekly open mic.

Atmosphere and Setting

The mill-building setting gives Courthouse a warm, industrial-chic taproom feel, popular with the local Worcester community as a gathering spot.

Open Mic Night

Every Thursday, Courthouse hosts a general music open mic hosted by Bridget Nault, with sign-ups from 6:30 PM and music from 6:00 to 9:00 PM.

Other Programming

As a neighborhood taproom, Courthouse's calendar centers on the weekly open mic as a community favorite alongside its regular beer offerings.

Good to Know

Courthouse Brew Co. is located at 3 Brussels Street in Worcester, in the same historic mill complex as KrafTea Kombucha.

title: The Raven
venue_description:
The Raven

The Raven, also known as The Raven Music Hall, is a Worcester live music venue that mixes touring and local booked bands with a weekly open jam session.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Raven has the feel of a proper music hall, built for bands and instrumentalists rather than a casual bar.

Thursday Jams

Every Thursday, The Raven hosts an open jam described as bring-your-instrument-and-throw-down, hosted by Ari Sky Walker.

Other Programming

Beyond the weekly jam, The Raven regularly books touring and local bands as part of its broader concert calendar.

Good to Know

The Raven is located at 258 Pleasant Street in Worcester.

title: BirchTree Bread Company
venue_description:
BirchTree Bread Company

BirchTree Bread Company is a beloved Worcester bakery and pizza restaurant known for scratch-made bread and pizza, with a cozy, community-oriented vibe and regular live music programming.

Atmosphere and Setting

BirchTree draws a loyal local following for breakfast through dinner, and its Friday nights bring cocktails and live music into the mix alongside the food.

Open Mic Night

On the first Friday of the month, BirchTree hosts an open mic from 6:30 to 9:00 PM with sign-up starting at 6:00 PM.

Other Programming

Beyond the monthly open mic, BirchTree regularly books Friday night live music as part of its weekly calendar.

Good to Know

BirchTree Bread Company is located at 138 Green Street in Worcester.

title: Cafe on the Common
venue_description:
Cafe on the Common

Cafe on the Common is a small, owner-operated American cafe, bar, and pub on the Barre town common, known for scratch-made food and a full bar.

Atmosphere and Setting

Run by a married couple, the cafe has an easygoing small-town feel with outdoor seating on the common, a natural gathering spot for the community.

Open Mic Night

Thursday nights bring a weekly open mic with sign-ups starting around 6:00 PM, running until 8:00 PM.

Other Programming

Beyond its open mic, the cafe is known locally for scratch-made desserts, including a well-regarded banana cream pie.

Good to Know

Cafe on the Common is located at 2 Common Street in Barre.

title: New Dawn Arts Center
venue_description:
New Dawn Arts Center

New Dawn Arts Center is a volunteer-run, nonprofit, secular community arts organization in a historic property at the corner of Chapel and Main Streets in Ashburnham.

Atmosphere and Setting

New Dawn is an all-ages community arts hub rather than a bar or restaurant, hosting classes, concerts, theater, art markets, and galleries throughout the year.

The Openest Mic

On a monthly Thursday evening, New Dawn hosts a numbered, long-running open mic and acoustic music jam series known as The Openest Mic, running from 6:30 to 8:30 PM.

Other Programming

Beyond its open mic series, New Dawn's calendar spans theater productions, art markets, classes, and community events for all ages.

Good to Know

New Dawn Arts Center is located at 84 Main Street in Ashburnham.

title: Otter River Pub "The Onion"
venue_description:
Otter River Pub "The Onion"

Otter River Pub, also known as The Onion or the historic Red Onion, is an 1880 pub and hotel building in Baldwinville, extensively renovated after a September 2023 fire that gutted the structure. It reopened in February 2024 with a full roof rebuild, modern safety upgrades, and its vintage character preserved.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Onion mixes historic charm with a modern, safety-updated interior, and runs one of the busiest weekly live-entertainment lineups in the area.

Wednesday Night Open Mic

Wednesday nights bring an open mic produced by promoter Sound Bites Events, running from 7:00 to 10:00 PM, with sign-up in person at the venue about 30 minutes before the start.

Other Programming

The pub's weekly lineup also includes Thursday acoustic performers, Friday karaoke, and Saturday full band shows.

Good to Know

Otter River Pub is located at 29 Main Street in the Baldwinville village of Templeton.

title: Timberyard Brewing Company
venue_description:
Timberyard Brewing Company

Timberyard Brewing Company is a craft brewery in East Brookfield with a full BBQ and comfort food menu, hard seltzer cocktails, and live music most weekends.

Atmosphere and Setting

Timberyard has the relaxed feel of a modern brewery taproom, with both indoor and outdoor space and a private event area.

Bluegrass Jam and Open Mic

On the first Sunday of the month, Timberyard hosts a bluegrass circle jam from 12:30 to 4:00 PM led by Jordan Richmond, welcoming pickers of all skill levels. On the third Thursday of the month, the brewery hosts a separate general open mic hosted by "Mama."

Other Programming

Timberyard's calendar otherwise features live music most weekends alongside its food and beer offerings.

Good to Know

Timberyard Brewing Company is located at 555 East Main Street in East Brookfield.
location: 555 East Main Street, East Brookfield, MA 01515

title: Lost Towns Brewing
venue_description:
Lost Towns Brewing

Lost Towns Brewing is a craft brewery in downtown Ware with an in-house full backline for performers, making it especially accessible for musicians who don't want to haul their own gear.

Atmosphere and Setting

The brewery has an inviting downtown taproom feel, with a weekly open mic that has become a well-documented community fixture.

Open Mic Night

Every Friday from 6:00 to 8:00 PM, Lost Towns hosts an open mic welcoming both music and comedy, hosted by A.J., Dave, and Karyn of the band Water Bear. A full backline is provided, and performers reserve their slot through a SignUpGenius link in advance.

Other Programming

As a downtown brewery, Lost Towns also hosts other seasonal and community events throughout the year.

Good to Know

Lost Towns Brewing is located at 44 East Main Street in Ware.

title: Workshop13
venue_description:
Workshop13

Workshop13 is a cultural arts and learning center in downtown Ware offering classes, workshops, and community arts programming, including both a music open mic and a separate poetry-focused open mic.

Atmosphere and Setting

Workshop13 has the feel of a genuine community arts hub, hosting a broad range of creative programming beyond just music.

Open Stage

On the third Friday of the month, Workshop13 hosts Open Stage, a music open mic co-hosted by Briezyjane and Rob Griffin, with doors at 6:30 PM and performances starting at 7:00 PM. The series has historically taken a break over the summer months.

Other Programming

Workshop13 also runs The Word at Workshop13, a separate poetry-focused open mic, alongside its classes and workshops.

Good to Know

Workshop13 is located at 13 Church Street in Ware.

title: Seven Railroads Brewing Company
venue_description:
Seven Railroads Brewing Company

Seven Railroads Brewing Company is a neighborhood-focused, dog-friendly craft brewery taproom in Palmer, opened in 2024 by owners Rachel Rosenbloom and Michael Bedrosian and named for Palmer's historical identity as the town of seven railroads.

Atmosphere and Setting

The taproom has a vintage feel, with aged hardwood floors and a record player, and regularly hosts food trucks since it does not serve its own food.

Open Mic Night

Every Thursday from 6:00 to 9:00 PM, Seven Railroads hosts a general open mic as a core weekly event for the taproom.

Other Programming

As a young, community-focused brewery, Seven Railroads leans on its open mic and food-truck partnerships as its main recurring events.

Good to Know

Seven Railroads Brewing Company is located at 1235 Park Street in Palmer.

title: Victoria Bar
venue_description:
Victoria Bar

Victoria Bar, known locally as The Vic, is a downtown Greenfield dive bar with nearly a century of history, recently passed to new owners Angel and Phil Simon in 2025 after the previous owners' 34-year run.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Vic is a classic dive bar — sports on the TVs, darts, trivia, and a loyal regular crowd — with the new owners working to modernize the space while keeping its character intact.

Sunday Open Mic

Sunday evenings bring an open mic, bring-your-own-instrument style, as part of the bar's weekly entertainment lineup.

Other Programming

Victoria Bar also runs karaoke nights, free DJ sets on Fridays, a monthly cook-off, and hosts watch parties for the Pioneer Valley Armoury soccer supporters' group.

Good to Know

Victoria Bar is located at 4 Chapman Street in downtown Greenfield. As the bar recently changed hands, it's worth checking ahead for the current open mic schedule.

title: The Doc & Witch
venue_description:
The Doc & Witch

The Doc & Witch is a cozy cocktail bar and lounge in downtown Greenfield, known for soft lighting and artisan cocktails, with ownership passed to a longtime patron in 2023.

Atmosphere and Setting

The lounge has an intimate, low-lit feel geared toward cocktails and conversation, with karaoke and trivia as its most consistently advertised weekly programming.

Acoustic Open Mic

Saturday nights have hosted an acoustic open mic at The Doc & Witch; as with any smaller, informally promoted series, it's worth checking the bar's Facebook page ahead of a visit to confirm the current schedule.

Other Programming

The Doc & Witch runs Tuesday karaoke and Thursday trivia as its regular weekly programming.

Good to Know

The Doc & Witch is located at 4 Ames Street in downtown Greenfield.

title: The Rendezvous
venue_description:
The Rendezvous

The Rendezvous, known locally as the Voo, is a casual, artsy pub and bistro in Turners Falls known for an eclectic menu, good food, and local entertainment.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Voo has a relaxed, artsy pub feel that fits its role as a longtime hub for Turners Falls' local music community, with the kitchen staying open late on show nights.

Open Mic Night

On the first and third Monday of the month, the Voo hosts an open mic hosted by Jim McRae, with sign-up from 7:30 PM and music from 8:30 to 10:30 PM. The kitchen stays open until 9:00 PM on open mic nights.

Other Programming

Beyond the open mic, the Rendezvous is known for booking local entertainment as a regular part of its business.

Good to Know

The Rendezvous is located at 78 3rd Street in Turners Falls.

title: Montague Common Hall
venue_description:
Montague Common Hall

Montague Common Hall is a historic community hall in Montague Center, built in 1835 as a Unitarian Meetinghouse and now home to the Montague Historical Society, featuring neo-Gothic architecture and a small stage with piano.

Atmosphere and Setting

The hall is a genuine community space rather than a bar, with a rustic kitchen and dining hall, making it an all-ages-appropriate venue for its monthly open mic series.

2nd Saturday Open Mic

On the second Saturday of the month from 6:30 to 9:00 PM, the hall hosts an open mic that pairs a randomly-chosen featured performer with an open floor for other musicians.

Other Programming

As a historical society property, Montague Common Hall also hosts community and heritage-related events throughout the year.

Good to Know

Montague Common Hall is located at 34 Main Street in Montague Center.

title: The National Spiritual Alliance
venue_description:
The National Spiritual Alliance

The National Spiritual Alliance is a historic Spiritualist church operating out of the Thompson Temple in the Lake Pleasant Spiritualist campground village in Montague. The temple reopened in 2025 and now hosts sober, all-ages, intergenerational community music programming.

Atmosphere and Setting

As a religious community rather than a bar, the temple offers a genuinely sober, welcoming, listening-room atmosphere, with suggested donations rather than cover charges.

Voices in the Village & Jam in the Round

On the third Tuesday of the month, the temple hosts Voices in the Village, a community open mic for original songs, traditional music, and acoustic performances, hosted by Tobey Sol LaRoche and co-presented with the Shea Theater. On the second Sunday of the month, a separate participatory event called Jam in the Round, facilitated by Olivia Nied, welcomes all skill levels including non-musicians, with basic backline provided.

Other Programming

Both series are supported by the Montague Cultural Council and Massachusetts Cultural Council, and Voices in the Village is filmed by Montague Community Television.

Good to Know

The National Spiritual Alliance is located at 2 Montague Avenue in Lake Pleasant. Suggested contribution is $5 to $20, with no one turned away for lack of funds.

title: Floodwater Brewing Co.
venue_description:
Floodwater Brewing Co.

Floodwater Brewing Co. is a craft brewery and taproom in downtown Shelburne Falls with a varied weekly events calendar spanning comedy, live music, trivia, and a well-established open mic.

Atmosphere and Setting

The taproom has an inviting downtown feel, popular for its full weekly slate of community programming beyond just beer.

Open Mic Night

Every Thursday from 7:00 to 9:00 PM, Floodwater hosts a free, general open mic as one of its most consistent weekly draws.

Other Programming

Floodwater's calendar also includes comedy nights and trivia as part of its broader weekly entertainment mix.

Good to Know

Floodwater Brewing Co. is located at 40 State Street in Shelburne Falls.

title: Incandescent Brewing
venue_description:
Incandescent Brewing

Incandescent Brewing is a family-owned production brewery and taproom in Bernardston led by head brewer Nathan Perry, offering craft beer, hard seltzer, and seltzer cocktails alongside a busy live-entertainment calendar.

Atmosphere and Setting

The taproom hosts weekly live entertainment spanning folk, bluegrass, and comedy, with banquet and function space also available.

Open Mic Night

On a monthly Thursday evening, Incandescent hosts a free open mic open to all skill levels, with 15-minute sign-up sets from 5:00 to 8:30 PM.

Other Programming

Beyond the open mic, Incandescent's calendar includes ticketed folk and bluegrass concerts as part of its regular entertainment lineup.

Good to Know

Incandescent Brewing is located at 203 South Street in Bernardston.

title: Shire Tavern
venue_description:
Shire Tavern

Shire Tavern, self-described as "your neighborhood gathering spot in the heart of Dalton," is a gastropub operated by Berkshire Culinary Group, offering seasonal plates, classic pub fare, and late-night pizza on weekends.

Atmosphere and Setting

The tavern has pool tables and shuffleboard for entertainment and can accommodate private events for up to 120 guests, giving it a comfortable, community-hangout feel.

Live Music & Jam Night

On the third Thursday of the month, Shire Tavern hosts a live music and open jam night as part of its entertainment calendar.

Other Programming

Beyond the monthly jam, Shire Tavern regularly features live music from local artists.

Good to Know

Shire Tavern is located at 63 Flansburg Avenue in Dalton.

title: Studio 9
venue_description:
Studio 9

Studio 9 is a dedicated recording studio and performance venue tied to The Porches Inn, a boutique hotel on the MASS MoCA campus in North Adams, with professional-grade acoustics and lighting.

Atmosphere and Setting

Studio 9 bills itself as more than a casual bar open mic — a genuine showcase space for the Northern Berkshires' creative community, with higher production values than a typical open mic room.

Tuesday Open Mic

Every Tuesday, Studio 9 hosts an open mic welcoming diverse talents, from seasoned musicians to emerging performers, with sign-up at 6:30 PM and the show starting at 7:00 PM.

Other Programming

Studio 9 also hosts ticketed concerts and programs in partnership with the Berkshire Arts & Music Society, including artist showcases and themed performance nights.

Good to Know

Studio 9 is located at 231 River Street in North Adams, on The Porches Inn campus near MASS MoCA.

title: Bounti-Fare Restaurant & Catering
venue_description:
Bounti-Fare Restaurant & Catering

Bounti-Fare is a full-service New American restaurant and catering business in Adams that bills itself as home to the best open mic night in the Berkshires, alongside off-premise catering and wedding coordination.

Atmosphere and Setting

Bounti-Fare has an easygoing restaurant-bar feel, with an ever-changing entertainment schedule — the restaurant encourages patrons to call ahead to confirm the current lineup.

Open Mic Nights

Bounti-Fare hosts an open mic every Wednesday at 7:30 PM, plus a second open mic on the first Friday of the month.

Other Programming

The restaurant also hosts live music from Jazz Gruppo Mondo on the first Thursday of the month, and runs a separate comedy night series.

Good to Know

Bounti-Fare is located at 200 Howland Avenue (Route 8) in Adams.

title: The Egremont Barn
venue_description:
The Egremont Barn

The Egremont Barn is a rustic, barn-set live music, comedy, and karaoke venue in South Egremont near Great Barrington, attached to the Egremont Village Inn, with a pub serving comfort food.

Atmosphere and Setting

Known regionally as a lively entertainment venue rather than just a restaurant, the Barn is listed alongside larger touring concert venues in Berkshire press coverage.

Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday, the Barn hosts a free, popular open mic from 7:00 to 10:00 PM, with sign-up starting at 6:00 PM, described as always filled with local talent.

Other Programming

Beyond the open mic, the Barn's calendar includes touring bands, comedy shows, and karaoke nights.

Good to Know

The Egremont Barn is located at 17 Main Street in South Egremont.

title: The Foundry
venue_description:
The Foundry

The Foundry is an established, well-regarded arts and performance venue in West Stockbridge with a professionally produced calendar spanning music, comedy, drag, cabaret, and variety shows.

Atmosphere and Setting

With a full bar and a reputation as a happening spot in the community, The Foundry draws a lively crowd for its consistently creative programming.

Open Mic Night

On the second and fourth Thursday of the month, The Foundry hosts an open mic open to singing, dancing, poetry, and comedy, with bar and sign-up from 5:00 to 5:30 PM and performances starting at 6:30 PM.

Other Programming

The Foundry's broader calendar includes klezmer nights, improv, burlesque-style variety shows, and comedy.

Good to Know

The Foundry is located at 2 Harris Street in West Stockbridge.

title: Route 8 Pub
venue_description:
Route 8 Pub

Route 8 Pub is a family-owned neighborhood pub and restaurant in Becket known for wings, burgers, and pizza, under local ownership since 2024.

Atmosphere and Setting

A small, roughly 50-seat interior with outdoor picnic tables gives Route 8 Pub a cozy, community feel, with live sports and a loyal local following.

Community Open Jam

Every Wednesday, the pub hosts a Community Open Jam featuring acoustic jamming and solo musicians or duos.

Other Programming

As a family-run neighborhood pub, Route 8's calendar centers on the weekly jam alongside its food and drink offerings.

Good to Know

Route 8 Pub is located at 3235 Main Street in Becket.

title: Marigold (Brattleboro)
venue_description:
Marigold (Brattleboro)

Marigold is a riverfront bar, cafe, and live music venue in downtown Brattleboro, Vermont, with a patio overlooking the river and mountain views. It opened in 2024 under the same ownership as Marigold Theater in Easthampton, Massachusetts, at the address previously home to River Garden Marketplace.

Atmosphere and Setting

Marigold Brattleboro is billed as beer, cocktails, good food, and live music, with a calendar that runs from open mic nights to funk nights, jazz trios, and honky-tonk and two-step evenings.

Monday Open Mic

Every Monday, Marigold hosts a free, warm, community-first open mic hosted by musician and instructor Kevin Parry. The cafe opens at 5:00 PM, the mic goes live at 6:30 PM, and performances run from 7:00 to 10:00 PM, welcoming all voices and instruments.

Other Programming

Marigold's broader calendar spans punk, indie, and experimental acts, rock, blues, and Americana, bluegrass, and multi-band showcase nights.

Good to Know

Marigold Brattleboro is located at 157 Main Street, Brattleboro, Vermont, a short walk from downtown. Note that this is a separate location from Marigold Theater in Easthampton, Massachusetts, though the two share ownership.
